scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @stante/web && npm run build -w @stante/api
scripts.start: npm run db:deploy -w @stante/api && npm run start -w @stante/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @stante/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @stante/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
